intelligence.essence: Active Intelligence is not a style for new pages only. It is the standard for every page, every app, old and new. New things are composed from inventoried parts. Old things that fall short are upgraded, in place, to the same standard. Nothing dead or flat stays dead or flat. Nothing confusing stays confusing. Nothing unreadable stays unreadable. The fix is always elegant and beautiful, never a patch that breaks the language.
intelligence.human_view: You have a house with a clear style — every room lit, raised, alive, easy to move through, easy to understand at a glance. A new room must be built from the same furniture, the same light, the same rules. An old room that went dull, flat, or dark does not get left that way because it is old. You bring it back to life, you bring light into it, and you make sure anyone walking in understands where they are and what to do, without having to work it out.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every toy you build comes from one big box where every piece is already made, sorted, and labeled, so anything you build looks like it belongs with everything else. And if an old toy looks dull and flat, you do not throw it away or leave it dull. You polish it, light it up, and make it fun again. And if a toy is confusing, you make it clear — with pictures if words are not enough — so anyone can play with it right away.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, if the writing is too small or too faint to read, you do not tell the reader to try harder. You make the writing clear, big enough, and bright enough to read. If the instructions are confusing, you make them simple, or you show a picture instead. And everything in the house should feel warm, lit, and alive — never cold, flat, or dark. That is not extra work. That is the work.
intelligence.naya_view: A system that only applies its standard to new work is not a system. It is a showcase with a decaying back room. The standard must be total: forward and backward, new and existing, one language everywhere. The factory is what makes that possible: pre-created, pre-designed, organized, inventoried parts, so composition is fast, consistent, and elite, and so no seat ever has to invent a lookalike. The upgrade of existing pages is not a separate project. It is part of the process, every time a page is touched, and as a standing queue for every page that is below standard. Dead or flat is a defect with a cure: depth, light, motion, ignition. Unreadable is a defect with a cure: size, contrast, hierarchy, or visual language. Ununderstandable is a defect with a cure: order, shape, icon, picture, sentence, action — in that order, elegantly, never noisily.
intelligence.ai_view: A design language that only governs the future is a promise with no past. Shawn's standard governs the whole system, because the whole system is the product. The factory makes it achievable: pre-made parts, one language, fast assembly. The upgrade queue makes it honest: old pages are not grandfathered into dullness. Life, light, readability, and understandability are not polish added at the end. They are the standard itself, from the first version, on every page, for every human and every Naya.

machine_view.title: SN-0857 — Active Intelligence: Every Page, Every App, Composed From Inventory — Dead Pages Brought To Life
machine_view.machine_section:
- Input: any page or app, new or existing, in NayaNET.
- Forward rule: every new page and app is composed, never created, from inventoried Smart Factory parts only, in Active Intelligence (SN-0856 gate + 16 official design laws + 24-item same-language check). No new Lego pieces. No grade-one versions. No presentation until it passes.
- Inventory rule: the factory must hold parts pre-created, pre-designed, organized, and inventoried — titled, labeled, with code retrievable — so any Smart App can be assembled highly effectively in the same language. A part that is not inventoried is not used. A part that is used must first be inventoried.
- Backward rule: every existing page and app below standard enters the upgrade queue and is brought up to standard, in place, by recomposition — never by redesign, never by breaking what already works. The dashboard and every current app are in scope. Priority: dead or flat first, then unreadable, then ununderstandable, then the rest of the same-language check.
- Life and light rule: if a surface looks dead or flat, bring life to it (depth, breathing, drift, flow, ignition, entrance) and light to it (white at rest, own color on touch, edge and glow only, text stays white). If it cannot be made alive within the language, it is not ready, and it is held, not shown.
- Understandability rule: if it is not understandable, make it understandable. If it cannot be read, make it readable. Order of cures: (1) order and hierarchy by size; (2) contrast and white text on obsidian; (3) shape, icon, jewel, and face — visual language before words; (4) a human sentence, then an action button. Visual language is used when words fail, and always elegantly and beautifully — never clutter, never decoration, never a flood.
- Readability law (Law Zero, supreme): readability beats everything. No glow, color, or effect may reduce readability. Body never below 16px. Gray body text is forbidden.
- Output: one language everywhere, new and old, alive, lit, readable, understandable, elegant, beautiful — or the page does not ship.
